response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced (15+ years) individual-contributor engineer with broad technical breadth and some exposure to developer tooling and testing infrastructure, but his resume shows no evidence of formal people management, direct reports, or team leadership responsibilities, which are core, non-negotiable requirements for this Engineering Manager role. His career trajectory has remained consistently IC-focused despite senior/staff titles.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse full-stack, mobile, and systems engineering experience
Direct experience building developer tools and testing infrastructure (Trial test runner, Fluent-Asserts, CI/CD setup, MCP tooling)
Demonstrated mentoring/teaching ability through workshops, talks, and Refactoring Dojos
concerns: No evidence of formal people management, direct reports, or performance review responsibilities
Career has remained purely IC (Senior/Staff Developer) with no team-lead or managerial titles
Limited mobile platform depth relevant to a large mobile ecosystem (only brief iOS/AppleTV work years ago)
